title: PEB Store Shed for Haier, 32,400 Sq Ft | Steel Mind
description: Steel Mind built a 32,400 sq ft PEB store shed for Haier at Raiwind: 30 ft high, 180 ft wide and 180 ft long, with a wide open floor for storage.
h1: PEB Store Shed for Haier at Raiwind: 32,400 Square Feet of Open Storage Space
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. designed, fabricated and erected a pre-engineered store shed for Haier at Raiwind, Lahore. The shed is 30 feet high, 180 feet wide and 180 feet long and covers 32,400 square feet.
alt: PEB store shed built by Steel Mind for Haier at Raiwind, Lahore.

faq.q: How big is the Haier store shed?
faq.a: It covers 32,400 square feet and stands 30 feet high.

faq.q: Can a store shed like this be extended?
faq.a: Yes. Bolted PEB frames allow extra bays.

blocks.text: A manufacturer needs covered space close to its plant to hold material and stock. Steel Mind built this store as a pre-engineered building. The frames were designed in advance, made in the Steel Mind factory in Lahore and bolted together on site.

A shed of this width gives a large open floor for racks, pallets and vehicle movement. The 30-foot height leaves room for stacking and for handling equipment. Because the building is bolted, bays can be added later if the store needs to grow.
Steel Mind can deliver a store of more than 32,000 square feet under one contract. It has built four structures for Haier at Raiwind.
